prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph inside the reception of a cheap English bed-and-breakfast at night. Behind an empty wooden counter with a brass bell, a wall of numbered room keys on hooks, each with a worn plastic fob, runs up past the ceiling and back down a narrow corridor into darkness, rows multiplying until they blur into a texture. One key fob in the foreground, sharp, is stamped in plain black numerals "134,210". A single flickering fluorescent tube gives cold teal light, magnolia walls, swirly carpet, fire-door sign without words. 35mm lens, cheap colour film, grain, faint halation, no people. Thanks.
